scores.+2: Talar head palpable on medial side only (marked pronation)

talonavicular_bulging.name: Bulging in Region of Talonavicular Joint

scores.+2: Area is markedly bulging / prominent convex bulge (marked pronation)

medial_longitudinal_arch.name: Height and Congruence of Medial Longitudinal Arch

forefoot_abduction_adduction.name: Abduction / Adduction of Forefoot on Rearfoot

scores.-2: No lateral toes visible, medial toes prominent (marked adduction)
scores.-1: Medial toes more visible than lateral toes

pronation.summary: Medial arch lowering and calcaneal eversion correlate with reduced medial longitudinal arch tension and lengthened/eccentrically loaded Deep Front Line structures (tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus).

supination.summary: High rigid medial arch and calcaneal inversion correlate with increased stiffness in the Superficial Back Line (plantar fascia, Achilles tendon, gastrocnemius complex) and lateral weight-bearing bias along the Spiral Line.
upstream_kinetic_influences: Reduced ground reaction force shock absorption

neutral.summary: Balanced tension distribution between medial arch stabilizers (DFL) and lateral peroneals (LL), with optimal shock absorption capacity.
